topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this just happened. My car, gone! Just like that, from my own driveway. I mean, who does that? You're sitting there, minding your own business, and suddenly this nightmare. I’ve been on the phone for hours, trying to figure out where they took it and how to get it back. These towing places, they make it so hard. Like, seriously, what kind of sick joke is this? Now I’ve got to pay some ridiculous fee just to have my own car back. I swear, if I ever find out who's responsible, I’m going to have a few choice words for them. But right now, I just need to breathe and figure out what to do next.
